senses.gloss: --a son of राक्षस Paurus2eya. Br. III. 7. ९४.
(I)--a devi attending on Soma. Br. II. २६. ४५; III. ६५. २६.

(II)--(Vayu) a daughter of दक्ष; wife of Dharma and mother of व्यवसाय;
1: वा. १०. २५, ३६; Vi. I. 7. २३, ३०.
one of the nine देवीस् serving Soma.
2: वा. ५५. ४३; ९०. २५.

(I)--(अतिबाहु) a son of Priyavrata; king of साल्मलिद्वीप; father of seven sons who were founders of seven kingdoms--श्वेत, Harita, जीमूत, Rohita, Vaidyuta, मानस, and Suprabha. Br. II. १४. १२, ३२-4; वा. ३१. १७; ३३. 9, १२; Vi. II. 1. 7. १३.
(II)--(भार्गव)--a sage of the epoch of III सावर्ण Manu. Br. IV. 1. ७८.
(III)--a sage of the XI epoch of Manu. Vi. III. 2. ३१.
--a R. in the भद्रा country. वा. ४३. २७.
(I)--the construction of small ponds at the auspicious time; the same prescription for excavating तडागस् (tanks). M. ५८. 1, ५१.
(II)--one of the ten पीठस् for images with two mekhalas. M. २६२. 6, 8. [page३-190+ ३५]
